followUpApprovals.feature: SCOPE - Remove Duplicate Pop Out Controls
followUpApprovals.authorization: Explicit user request to fix duplicate managed title-bar controls; no Window Manager redesign.
followUpApprovals.rootCause: Managed windows share integration-pane styling. The legacy classic-pane decorator injected another shell Pop Out action and inferred a left/right application, which could open the wrong application. Both handlers use ScopeOperator detach; neither control comes from application-owned UI.
followUpApprovals.retainedHandler: data-managed-action=popout -> ScopeOperator.detach(application index, managed application slot)
followUpApprovals.evidence: 48 combinations: four applications, four navigation modes and three representative themes; actual baseline investigation opened Display from the managed button and BLOS from the legacy button. New rendering keeps one control; classic split buttons remain.
followUpApprovals.limitations: Older exported HTML must be regenerated to embed the fix. Popup size/placement remain subject to browser/OS policy; native Chrome/Edge popup interaction is not asserted by controlled DOM tests.
